blocks.title: Content lives in Git
blocks.body: Every change is saved with its history, so nothing you publish is ever lost, and any of it can be undone.

blocks.title: Nothing at runtime
blocks.body: Pages are built ahead of time and served as files. There is no server to fall over and nothing to slow a visitor down.

blocks.title: Your design stays yours
blocks.body: Editors change words and images, never the layout, so the site still looks the way it was designed on its hundredth edit.

blocks.text: We changed our opening hours ourselves for the first time in five years. It took a minute.
